outline.eyebrow: Why helpers only in the room
outline.title: Helpers change when they watch other helpers do it
outline.description:
Far more than when the mum asks again. And because nobody speaks honestly with their employer sitting beside them.

"It's not about doing more. It's about setting things up differently."

description.title: The child who won't eat
description.description: The bowl on the floor. The forty-five-minute dinner. The helper who keeps spooning it in because it's faster, and because nobody ever showed her another way.

items.title: 9:00 — What is really happening
items.description: When a toddler refuses food, most of it isn't about the food.

items.title: 9:20 — Hands on
items.description: Pouring, serving, and a real table set up the way it should be at home. Real jugs, real spills.

items.title: 10:10 — What to say instead
items.description: Don't say / say, practised out loud until it sounds natural.

items.title: 10:40 — One thing this week
items.description: Each helper picks the one thing she will set up this week, and leaves with it written down.

details.title: Two hours for her, forty minutes for you

items.title: Saturday, helpers only
items.description: Two hours of practice, not a lecture. Eight helpers in the room.

items.title: Tuesday parents' call
items.description: 40 minutes on Zoom, Tuesday 1 December at 8:30pm, once the children are down. What she learned, what it should look like at your table, and the three things parents usually do that undo it.

items.title: Saturday evening note
items.description: A short message the same evening so you know what to look for.

items.title: One payment, one family
items.description: HK$900 covers your helper on the Saturday and you on the Tuesday.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Families in Hong Kong with a child roughly 1 to 4, and a helper who is at the table for most of those meals.

items.question: Do parents attend the Saturday?
items.answer: No. Helpers only in the room on Saturday. Parents join the Tuesday call.

items.question: Where is it?
items.answer: Hong Kong Island. The exact address is sent a week before.

items.question: Is this a course?
items.answer: No. One Saturday roughly every six weeks, each on its own. Come to the one you need. 28 Nov 2026 — Mealtimes (booking now). 12 Dec 2026 — Tantrums and limits. 16 Jan 2027 — Getting dressed, getting out of the door. 20 Feb 2027 — Toys, play, and leaving them alone.

items.question: What does HK$900 include?
items.answer: Both sessions for one family: the Saturday workshop for your helper, and the Tuesday parents' call. Eight families, then it closes.
